To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed approach allows to evaluate complex systems by using simple models.
the integration of trace data into simulation models allows to create simple and accurate models for the evaluation of complex communication systems.
the use of a simulator is often not the best choice for the performance evaluation of wireless networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of measurements and simulation in the evaluation of wireless networks.
the development and application of a simulation methodology for the performance evaluation of wireless communication systems, based on the integration between simulation and measurement.
the integration of simulation tools and real data in order to evaluate complex systems and to support their development and deployment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach is very effective and efficient for the performance evaluation and optimization of wireless networks.
the proposed approach is a valid alternative to simulation and can provide a useful contribution for the design and optimization of wireless communication networks.

the proposed approach can be used to evaluate the performance of a wireless communication system in a very simple way, with no particular knowledge of the system, by using the trace files of a real implementation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed methodology allows the integration of real data into a simulation model, and thus the evaluation of the network performance in a more realistic scenario, without the need to develop a complex simulation model.
we have shown that it is possible to create a simulation model that is simple and easy to use and at the same time is able to reproduce a real system with good accuracy.
the proposed approach is a valid alternative to the traditional approach based on the development of simulation models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a trace file can be a good substitute for an accurate simulation of a complex communication network.
the integration of trace data into simulation models can be used as an alternative approach for the performance evaluation of communication systems.
simulation and measurement integration can be a powerful tool in the evaluation of complex systems, such as the one we have considered in this work.
